name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or surface.

labels: [enhancement]

## Use case

What you're trying to do — concrete user-facing scenario, not the implementation.

## Proposed approach

What API / CLI / endpoint / UI surface you envision. Sketch the call shape, request/response, or screen flow.

## Alternatives considered

What else you tried or thought about. Why this proposal beats those.

## Scope check

- [ ] Affects engine deterministic output (`src/synth/**`) — bumps a major if observable.
- [ ] Affects public HTTP API shape (`src/server/**`) — bumps a minor.
- [ ] Internal-only refactor / docs / tooling — patch-level.

## Additional context

Links to similar tools, references, prior art.
